# Every conda package of futurehouse/bixbench:aviary-notebook-env (linux/arm64,
# sha256:5f5dea50a0d37d252bcb1271c7fb843c0ce2e5fda4961279ca27eccd01208b5e) at the version
# that image has, so the linux/amd64 build reproduces it rather than resolving today's
# packages. Generated from `conda list --json` in that image; arm64-only package names
# are mapped to their linux-64 counterparts. Unversioned lines are packages whose arm64
# version cannot be installed on linux-64 beside the rest (repodata patches made since,
# or linux-64's own toolchain pairings, or no conda-forge build of that version);
# none is used by analysis code. Packages that image takes from Anaconda's channel
# (pkgs/main) are taken from conda-forge here, and its anaconda-anon-usage plugin is left
# out, so nothing comes from Anaconda's repositories.
